title: Slide Array Spotting
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare replicator and pins
steps.instruction: Use the custom 8‑pin replicator and its adapter to transfer samples from one Corning 96‑well flat plate (360 µL capacity) to a second plate column‑by‑column, keeping the same set of pins for the entire process and returning the pins after the protocol is finished.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App; refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
